name: Inside the Line - Independent Production Pipeline

parameters.jsCode:
// Change only topic and optional language settings here for a test run.
return [{json:{channel_id:"inside_the_line",topic:"",language:"English",format:"9:16 vertical",duration:"40-55 seconds",test_mode:true}}];

const r=$input.first().json; const parts=r.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts||[]; const raw=parts.map(p=>p.text||"").join("\\n").trim(); if(!raw) throw new Error("Gemini returned no text. Check GEMINI_API_KEY and model availability."); let out; try{out=JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\\x60\\x60\\x60json\\s*/,"").replace(/\\x60\\x60\\x60$/,""));}catch(e){throw new Error("Gemini response was not valid JSON: "+e.message+" | "+raw.slice(0,500));} return [{json:{...$node["Build Creative Brief"].json,package:out}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const p=d.package; if(!p.script||!Array.isArray(p.scenes)||p.scenes.length<2) throw new Error("Package validation failed: script and at least two scenes are required."); const total=p.scenes.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.duration_seconds||0),0); if(!Number.isFinite(total)||total<=0) throw new Error("Scene durations are missing or invalid."); const missing=p.scenes.filter(x=>!x.image_prompt||!x.image_to_video_prompt); if(missing.length) throw new Error("One or more scenes are missing image/video prompts."); return [{json:{...d,validation:{passed:true,scene_count:p.scenes.length,total_scene_seconds:total,duration_matches:Math.abs(total-Number(p.estimated_duration_seconds||total))<=3}}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const p=d.package; const scene_jobs=p.scenes.map(s=>({scene_number:s.scene_number,duration_seconds:s.duration_seconds,visual_description:s.visual_description,image_prompt:s.image_prompt,image_to_video_prompt:s.image_to_video_prompt,negative_prompt:p.global_negative_prompt,sound_design:s.sound_design,on_screen_text:s.on_screen_text})); return [{json:{...d,video_generation_handoff:{status:"READY_FOR_VIDEO_PROVIDER_CONNECTION",format:"9:16",scenes:scene_jobs,thumbnail_prompt:p.thumbnail_prompt}}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const narration=d.package.script||""; return [{json:{...d,voice_handoff:{status:"WAITING_FOR_VOICE_PROVIDER_CONNECTION",narration_text:narration,voice_direction:d.package.narrator_notes||d.profile.narration,language:"English",note:"No voice provider is called until its account/API credential is connected."}}}];

const d=$input.first().json; return [{json:{...d,youtube_handoff:{status:"WAITING_FOR_CHANNEL_OAUTH_CONNECTION",channel_name:d.profile.name,title:d.package.youtube_title,description:d.package.youtube_description,tags:d.package.tags,visibility:"private",note:"No upload is attempted. Connect and verify this channel's own YouTube OAuth credential before enabling upload."},workflow_safety:{test_mode:true,upload_enabled:false,channel_isolation:"one workflow = one channel"}}}];

meta.description: Independent workflow for Inside the Line. Only Gemini content planning is connected; video, voice and YouTube credentials are intentionally unconnected.
